theme: Mode et textiles : commande et confection

accroche.en: I want to order fifty shirts in three sizes and two colors.
accroche.fr: Je veux commander cinquante chemises en trois tailles et deux couleurs.

dialogue.en: Good afternoon. I want fifty shirts, sizes small, medium and large.
Blue and white, in cotton. Can I see a sample first?
Yes. The sample is 5,000 CFA, and I will deduct it from the order.
What is the price for fifty pieces?
8,000 CFA each. If you want it custom-made with your logo, it is 9,500 CFA.
What is the lead time for custom-made shirts?
Ten days. We do quality control before delivery.
Good. I will pay half now and half at delivery.

pratique_micro: Can I see a sample first?
Do you do quality control before delivery?

defi.en: Order thirty dresses custom-made with your logo. Ask for a sample, the lead time and a price for thirty pieces.
defi.fr: Commande trente robes sur mesure avec ton logo. Demande un échantillon, le délai de fabrication et un prix pour trente pièces, en anglais.

evaluation.q: How do you ask how long the production takes?
I want it ___, with my logo.

recap: Tu sais demander un échantillon, commander sur mesure, négocier un prix par quantité et fixer un délai.
